title.narrative: Morocco Decarbonisation and Climate Resilience programme

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the Programme is to support the decarbonisation and climate resilience of the Moroccan economy through an acceleration of the adoption of green technologies and sustainable practices by businesses in Morocco.

The Programme will contribute to the following specific objectives:

  1. Scaled-up green economy investments, including energy efficient, resource efficient, and renewable energy investments, contributing to the reduction of greenhouse gas emissions and increased climate resilience, and providing a demonstration effect in the market.
  2. Promoting the introduction and growth of innovative and under-utilised technologies in the market, such as investments in decarbonisation, circular economy, waste management, sustainable water management, and green buildings.
  3. Strengthening capacity of the financial sector to deploy sustainable, inclusive and green solutions and manage climate risk.
  4. Promoting more equitable access to green finance for women via mainstreaming gender considerations into Programme design and delivery.
  5. Awareness raising and capacity building of businesses in green investments and supporting them to develop bankable green projects.
  6. Promoting digitalisation through, for example, support of smart technology in manufacturing processes and introducing advanced data analytics in monitoring processes and other investments that support decarbonisation efforts.

To do so the EU contribution will be used in the form of technical assistance and investment grants.
